articles.title: Policeman Dragged, Stick Snatched — Violent Clash Caught on Camera in Gonda!
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A video from Gonda’s Hathibor Sakraur village shows a fierce scuffle between a youth and a uniformed policeman. The two are seen dragging, hitting, and attempting to snatch each other’s weapons. The clip has gone viral on social media.

body.html:
A video from Gonda’s Hathibor Sakraur village shows a fierce scuffle between a youth and a uniformed policeman. The two are seen dragging, hitting, and attempting to snatch each other’s weapons. The clip has gone viral on social media.

According to Gonda Police, Dial-112 had reached the village on a complaint of a fight between two brothers. Both parties, reportedly drunk, misbehaved with the police and assaulted Head Constable Girija Shankar.

Two named accused have been arrested and sent to jail. A case has been registered, and efforts are on to nab the remaining culprits.

articles.title: Tree Cries ‘Amrit’: Devotees Flock — Truth Leaves Everyone Shocked!
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A tree in Premlok Park, Pimpri Chinchwad, became the centre of a viral ‘miracle’ after locals saw water flowing from its trunk on Friday night. Believing it to be divine, residents garlanded the tree, applied turmeric, and collected the water, calling it amritdhara.

body.html:
A tree in Premlok Park, Pimpri Chinchwad, became the centre of a viral ‘miracle’ after locals saw water flowing from its trunk on Friday night. Believing it to be divine, residents garlanded the tree, applied turmeric, and collected the water, calling it amritdhara.

However, the mystery was soon solved. Following a complaint, civic officials found that a burst underground pipeline had caused water to seep through the tree’s base. The Pimpri Chinchwad Municipal Corporation clarified it was no miracle, just a leak.

Despite the clarification, the incident sparked a meme fest and spiritual frenzy online. Repairs are now underway to fix the pipe and the confusion.

articles.title: Food Delay Sparks Chaos: Ghaziabad Restaurant Turns Warzone Over Late Service!
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: #InShort | Chaos broke out at Rasoi Restaurant in Rajnagar Extension after a group of youths vandalized the premises over delayed food service. Chairs flew, furniture was smashed, and panic spread. CCTV footage captured the rampage—police have launched a manhunt.

body.html:
#InShort | Chaos broke out at Rasoi Restaurant in Rajnagar Extension after a group of youths vandalized the premises over delayed food service. Chairs flew, furniture was smashed, and panic spread. CCTV footage captured the rampage—police have launched a manhunt.

* * *

Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh – Chaos erupted at Rasoi Restaurant in Rajnagar Extension on Sunday night after a group of youths allegedly created a ruckus over delayed food service. The situation escalated into violent vandalism, with chairs and tables thrown and property damaged.

CCTV footage from the restaurant captured the entire incident, showing customers dining peacefully before a sudden outbreak of violence. According to reports, the group became aggressive after their food order was delayed. They reportedly abused staff members before resorting to smashing furniture and creating panic among other diners, who fled the premises.

Police arrived at the scene after receiving information but found the miscreants had already fled. Authorities have seized the CCTV footage, identified some suspects, and taken a few individuals into custody for questioning. A manhunt is underway to trace the remaining accused.

Local business owners and residents have expressed concern, calling the incident alarming and demanding increased police patrolling. Police have assured strict action and heightened security measures to maintain order.
